name: Retatrutide pen | 15 mg
description: Retatrutide is a next-generation GLP-1 peptide, supplied as a pre-filled, ready-to-use pen. No reconstitution required.
bodyHtml:
About

Retatrutide is a next-generation GLP-1 peptide and the flagship of our metabolic wellness range, chosen by people focused on body composition, energy and daily balance.

Supplied as a pre-filled pen, ready straight from the fridge, with no reconstitution and no measuring. The 15 mg pen is the smaller of the two pen strengths. Every batch is tested for purity and documented before dispatch.

  • Tracked dispatch from Germany
  • Handling insert with storage and use guidance
  • Batch documentation
